representation_plans.decisive_feature: The numerical sequence on consecutive labelled ticks determines whether equal spacing is additive or multiplicative.
representation_plans.learner_operation: Read two consecutive labels, name the scale rule, then interpret the displayed change.
representation_plans.prose_only_limitation: A paragraph cannot show that identical visual spacing can encode different numerical changes.
representation_plans.signaling_plan: Use axis labels, tick marks, and a text label such as ‘factor of 10’; do not rely on color, position, animation, or a marked correct option.
representation_plans.interaction_warrant: STATIC_VISUAL_IS_SUFFICIENT; no drag or animation is needed for the target operation.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State the axis title, unit, scale type only when already labelled, ordered tick labels, and the two marked coordinates or interval. Do not state the requested answer.
representation_plans.small_screen_behavior: Stack axis description above the response controls; never require horizontal panning.

representation_plans.decisive_feature: The two labelled coordinate pairs provide the numerator and denominator for the slope relationship.
representation_plans.learner_operation: Choose the two labelled points, subtract vertical values, subtract horizontal values, and divide in that order.
representation_plans.prose_only_limitation: The point-to-coordinate correspondence is easier to misread in prose than in an aligned display.
representation_plans.signaling_plan: Use matching point labels and a non-color marker shape; do not prefill the subtraction or highlight a response option.
representation_plans.interaction_warrant: STATIC_VISUAL_WITH_KEYBOARD_READABLE_TABLE; an interactive graph is not required.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: Provide an ordered table of the two labelled points, axis titles, and units. The table contains the same coordinate data but no computed slope.
representation_plans.small_screen_behavior: Show the coordinate table before the response controls; preserve the same task data at 320 px.

representation_plans.decisive_feature: Both original equations remain visible so the learner can preserve equality and verify the final ordered pair twice.
representation_plans.learner_operation: Isolate or select an expression, substitute it, solve, recover the second variable, and check both originals.
representation_plans.prose_only_limitation: A prose-only sequence hides the relationship between the substituted expression and the original pair of equations.
representation_plans.signaling_plan: Align equivalent variables and use row labels; no color-only grouping and no displayed answer before commitment.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: Read the first and second equation in a fixed order, followed by any substituted expression and blank verification prompts. No solution is supplied in an assessment screen.
representation_plans.small_screen_behavior: Stack equations vertically with semantic equation text and no clipped operators.

representation_plans.decisive_feature: Two differently phrased relationships must be retained simultaneously before solving.
representation_plans.learner_operation: Translate each stated relationship into a usable equation, then solve the resulting system.
representation_plans.prose_only_limitation: Separate wording can obscure that the formula and condition constrain the same pair of variables.
representation_plans.signaling_plan: Give each relationship a visible heading and preserve matching variable names; do not cue the translation or answer.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State the formula and condition as separate labelled text blocks with the same variable labels and no prewritten solution system.
representation_plans.small_screen_behavior: Stack formula and condition in source order before response options.

representation_plans.decisive_feature: A pair needs a separate check against each original equation.
representation_plans.learner_operation: Substitute the proposed values into the first original equation, then the second, and compare each resulting equality.
representation_plans.prose_only_limitation: A single verbal check can hide the missing second equation.
representation_plans.signaling_plan: Number the two rows and label them by equation; no row uses color as its only identifier.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: Read two labelled verification rows in order, each with the original equation and an unfilled substitution prompt.
representation_plans.small_screen_behavior: Transform rows into two headed blocks with no horizontal table scroll.

representation_plans.decisive_feature: The logarithm occupies the exponent role in the equivalent exponential statement.
representation_plans.learner_operation: Identify the base, exponent, and result; rewrite the relationship in the inverse form that exposes the requested unknown.
representation_plans.prose_only_limitation: A linear sentence can hide which symbol is the exponent and which symbol is the result.
representation_plans.signaling_plan: Align corresponding base, exponent, and result with text labels and spacing; no color-only correspondence and no answer cue.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State each equivalent expression in order and identify the role of base, exponent, and result without stating the requested response.
representation_plans.small_screen_behavior: Place equivalent forms in a vertical ordered pair at narrow widths.
